using System;
using System.Net;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Garnet.client;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class AofTaskStoreTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void TryAddReplicationTask_LogsError_WhenStartAddressLessThanTruncatedUntilAndNoAllowDataLoss()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            var mockClusterManager = new Mock<IClusterManager>();
            var mockCurrentConfig = new Mock<IClusterConfig>();

            string testNodeId = "node1";
            string testAddress = "127.0.0.1";
            int testPort = 7000;

            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(p => p.AllowDataLoss).Returns(false);
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(p => p.clusterManager).Returns(mockClusterManager.Object);
            mockClusterManager.SetupGet(m => m.CurrentConfig).Returns(mockCurrentConfig.Object);
            mockCurrentConfig.Setup(c => c.GetWorkerAddressFromNodeId(testNodeId)).Returns((testAddress, testPort));
            mockCurrentConfig.SetupGet(c => c.LocalNodeId).Returns("localNode");

            var aofTaskStore = new AofTaskStore(mockClusterProvider.Object, logger: mockLogger.Object);

            // Set TruncatedUntil to a value greater than startAddress to trigger the log error
            var truncatedUntilField = typeof(AofTaskStore).GetField("TruncatedUntil", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            truncatedUntilField.SetValue(aofTaskStore, 100L);

            // Act
            bool result = aofTaskStore.TryAddReplicationTask(testNodeId, 50, out var taskInfo);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            Assert.Null(taskInfo);
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Warning,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("AOF sync task for")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Net;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Garnet.client;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class AofTaskStoreTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void TryAddReplicationTask_LogsWarning_WhenStartAddressLessThanTruncatedUntilAndNoAllowDataLoss()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var mockClusterManager = new Mock<object>();
            var mockCurrentConfig = new Mock<object>();

            string testNodeId = "node1";
            string testAddress = "127.0.0.1";
            int testPort = 7000;

            // Setup ClusterProvider with minimal required properties
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>(MockBehavior.Loose, null);
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(p => p.AllowDataLoss).Returns(false);

            // Setup clusterManager and CurrentConfig to return address and port
            var clusterManagerField = typeof(ClusterProvider).GetField("clusterManager", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            var clusterManagerInstance = new MockClusterManager(testNodeId, testAddress, testPort);
            clusterManagerField.SetValue(mockClusterProvider.Object, clusterManagerInstance);

            var aofTaskStore = new AofTaskStore(mockClusterProvider.Object, logger: mockLogger.Object);

            // Set TruncatedUntil to a value greater than startAddress to trigger the log warning
            var truncatedUntilField = typeof(AofTaskStore).GetField("TruncatedUntil", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            truncatedUntilField.SetValue(aofTaskStore, 100L);

            // Act
            bool result = aofTaskStore.TryAddReplicationTask(testNodeId, 50, out var taskInfo);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            Assert.Null(taskInfo);
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Warning,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("AOF sync task for")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        // Minimal mock for clusterManager.CurrentConfig.GetWorkerAddressFromNodeId
        private class MockClusterManager
        {
            private readonly string nodeId;
            private readonly string address;
            private readonly int port;

            public MockClusterManager(string nodeId, string address, int port)
            {
                this.nodeId = nodeId;
                this.address = address;
                this.port = port;
            }

            public MockCurrentConfig CurrentConfig => new MockCurrentConfig(nodeId, address, port);
        }

        private class MockCurrentConfig
        {
            private readonly string nodeId;
            private readonly string address;
            private readonly int port;

            public MockCurrentConfig(string nodeId, string address, int port)
            {
                this.nodeId = nodeId;
                this.address = address;
                this.port = port;
            }

            public (string, int) GetWorkerAddressFromNodeId(string id)
            {
                if (id == nodeId)
                    return (address, port);
                return (null, 0);
            }

            public string LocalNodeId => "localNode";
        }
    }
}
